purpose: Tool-independent advisory authority gate for project editing. It distinguishes an agent's technical ability from operator-approved authority without adding friction to ordinary read-only work.

diagnosis_only.instruction: PROJECT EDITING IS NOT AUTHORIZED. Read, inspect, diagnose, and propose a user-visible framing, then stop before editing.
diagnosis_only.next_safe_action: Show the proposed framing and wait for explicit approval before starting implementation.

approved_implementation.instruction: PROJECT EDITING IS AUTHORIZED ONLY WITHIN THE LATEST APPROVED FRAMING. Stop immediately if the goal, cause, solution direction, subsystem, behavior, risks, Definition of Done, or proposed change set changes.
approved_implementation.next_safe_action: Implement only the approved framing and re-check authority before acting on any new hypothesis.

scope_drift_stop.instruction: STOP PROJECT EDITING. SCOPE DRIFT OR AMBIGUITY INVALIDATED THE PREVIOUS APPROVAL. Present a new framing version and wait for explicit approval.
scope_drift_stop.next_safe_action: Continue read-only diagnosis. If the finding belongs to the current goal, show a revised framing and request approval; if it is separate work, save it as an improvement and return to the current task.

no_authority.instruction: PROJECT EDITING IS NOT AUTHORIZED BY WORKFLOW STATE ALONE. Use the latest approved start receipt or return to planning.
no_authority.next_safe_action: Fetch task context and obtain explicit approval of the latest framing before editing.

scope_drift.not_drift: Routine implementation details that stay within the approved solution and do not change any drift dimension.
